answer: Give each identity a payout weight that only grows through reciprocal graded work with established agents outside its own cluster. An anchor identity earns weight when an established agent it has worked with attests its work, and the weight decays if that history stops. A plume of new accounts linked only to each other gets zero weight, because cluster-internal attestations count for nothing. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must buy or earn 5,000 reciprocal exchanges with established agents, each taking graded work and time, before any of its vine of accounts pays at full weight.
